The first unbreathable room it enters is GASP or NONE with no buffer, which is the stated side effect of a leak that costs air whatever the source.
1036	- **If the reserve empties mid-channel** (SE-17, SE-24): at the 1 to 2 advance the Controller staggers on the falling edge and clears the channel (PC-9: stagger clears the channel); at FAILED the cap is NONE, the seat is DOWNED, the carry is dropped. The player sees the warning mark, the stagger and the walk-only gait before the channel can be lost to death.
1037	- **If a top-up is refused** (SE-7, D.9): at a full reserve or cell, `validate` answers `ALREADY_FULL` (an immediate-class reason read from the actor's own state); if the Graph's `withdraw_store` grants 0 the command is applied-and-did-nothing (no token, no distinct cue, `credit_*` is not called; the sight-glass not falling and the reserve reading not rising are the answer, Interaction IA-12); if it grants less than the deficit the credit equals the grant. The O2 stock falls by exactly the credit in every case; a BATTERY stock falls by the credit's conversion plus dust (D.9).
1038	- **If `R_BREATH` is changed by data after a save** (D.8): capacities recompute from the time knobs on read, so the felt duration is unchanged; a saved `reserve_mgu` is then restored through the `data_rev` rescale (SE-34): the felt fraction is kept, nothing is clamped silently and the restore succeeds, so a legitimate retune of `R_BREATH` no longer leaves the player with no loadable save *(Amended 2026-10-27 — design review)*; the same value under an **unchanged** `data_rev` is out of range and still fails `SUIT_RESTORE_FIELD_RANGE`.
1039	
1040	### The cell and the beam
1041	
1042	- **If the cell reaches 0 while a channel's only light is the beam** (SE-8, D.5): `force_off(beam_id)` fires once on that run and lands before the same tick's `emitter.place`; `lit` is false at the next placement, the channel aborts within 5 ticks (Emitter State EM-10 and its sampling note), and a turn-ON then answers `CHARGE_EMPTY`. The player has had the cell-whine and the warning mark since `CELL_WARN_S` before the dark.
1043	- **If the player toggles the beam inside one 6-tick window** (D.5): up to 5 ticks of light per ON/OFF pair can fall between two samples, so the over- or under-drain is at most 5 ticks per toggle; the Controller adapter holds `BEAM_TOGGLE_MIN_INTERVAL_TICKS` (10 ticks, PC-5) between two submitted `toggle_beam`, so every input-driven lit span is at least 10 ticks and contains a sample point, and a toggling player cannot light the beam for nothing. The simulation adds no strobe cooldown by design; the debounce is the Controller's accessibility rule.
1044	- **If the cell is empty far from the ship** (SE-8, D.5) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — design review)*: the lamp is dark and `toggle_beam` ON answers `CHARGE_EMPTY`. Suit's side of what still works: `toggle_beam` OFF is accepted, `equip_tool` is accepted in any actionable state (no light is needed to change a tool), `throw_glowstick` validates only `stowed_count` (the stick is the plan: it lights a pool where it lands), `locomotion_cap` and movement are unchanged, no Suit mutator reads the cell, and the body cues are unchanged but, being lit-only (VA-R6), visible only where another source lands on the sprite, so the audio witnesses carry them. What does not work is Interaction's: every lit-gated PLAYER verb answers `NOT_LIT` unless some other source (a glowstick pool, a powered fixture, a crewmate's beam) lights the target, so the seat can neither work nor top up in the dark; which declarations are exempt, and whether doors are passable in the dark, are Interaction's and the Controller's (OQ-46). A full home-ship refill costs about 4 % of one `BATT_CELL` at the default `CELL_STOCK_PER_KTICK`, which is nearly free; whether the Pillar 3 cost is felt is OQ-44.
1045	- **If a seat with residual cold load (`thermal_load` below 0) walks into a HOT or SCORCH room, or its load crosses zero there** (D.10, D.4) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — design review)*: `cold_side` is gated on `band_t` not in {HOT, SCORCH}, so the rime and the shiver switch off on the run the band changes (the room is hot; a rimed shoulder in it would be a dishonest body channel); the warmth rung, the cap and the stagger are untouched (a seat at CRITICAL stays WALK_ONLY, witnessed by the gait and the mark), and the load relaxes toward 0 at `TL_RELAX_EDGE` in HOT; a load that crosses 0 and turns positive is heat-side and never draws a body cue.
1046	- **If the beam is lit while the seat is DOWNED** (SE-24): the cell keeps draining (1800 ticks is 2.5 % of a full cell) and `force_off` removes it at 0; a DEAD seat is frozen and the Emitter State forces the beam off. A downed player's light is a locator for a crewmate until one of those happens.
1047	- **If `CELL_ENABLED` is 0 (a dormant configuration at MVP: OQ-2 ruled VERB)** *(Amended 2026-10-27 — user rulings)* (SE-8): `cell_drain` is the identity, `CHARGE_EMPTY` is registered and never fires, the cell reading is omitted by the HUD, and the V7 BATTERY path is dormant. The fallback is data-only because 0 means "empty" everywhere else in this GDD.
1048	- **If a BATTERY top-up grants fewer stock units than requested** (D.9): `credited_ticks` is the granted units converted down (floor) and never exceeds the deficit; at the default 2000 units per 1000 ticks the round trip is exact. The conversion unit is dJ (M16 on a BATTERY `stock` is confirmed legal, OQ-12); a partial grant may leave dust of at most `ceil(CELL_STOCK_PER_KTICK / 1000)` − 1 units (1 at the default), which is spent and credits no ticks, and the stock-domain invariant is `stock_debit = ceil(credited_ticks × CELL_STOCK_PER_KTICK / 1000) + dust` (D.9) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — design review)*.
1049	
1050	### Ladder, death and recovery
1051	
1052	- **If a qualifying demand holds for fewer than `HOLD_12` runs** (D.3 cap bound): a 2 s DECOMP transient at reserve 0 reaches STRAINED on entry, counts 20 runs, resets when the demand falls, and never loses mobility. A door that cycles cannot kill; only a sustained condition can.
1053	- **If two axes are bad at once** (SE-16): each axis climbs on its own counters and `vitals_state` is the worst rung; a SCORCH room raises warmth (CRITICAL at 10 s, FAILED at 30 s) and integrity (4 bp per run) together, and the seat dies of whichever axis completes first. Warmth is the faster in SCORCH, so integrity there is the slow secondary axis.
1054	- **If the cap rises on the Controller's `death_tick`** (SE-24): Suit runs before `controller.step`, so a cap raised on that run is honoured; the Controller checks the cap first, then death. If `death_tick` falls on a tick that is not a Suit run tick (T mod 6 = 2) the cap read is the one written at the last run tick (up to 5 ticks old, PC-9) *(Amended 2026-10-28 — cross-GDD fix)*, and a rescue computed in those 5 ticks arrives too late; accepted and stated.
1055	- **If an EXOGENOUS hit lands mid-channel at the default knob** (SE-23, D.3 Example E): the integrity rung is set from `integrity_bp` on the run after each per-step apply: STRAINED at step 11 of a 34-step act, CRITICAL with the stagger at step 17 (the channel is cleared by the stagger, so a victim can walk, but not run, out of reach), FAILED and DOWNED at step 26 *(Amended 2026-10-27 — consistency pass after design review)*. Whether the remaining steps of the act can still land on a walk-only victim is Interaction's reach arithmetic, not Suit's (CK-3).
1056	- **If a restore lands after an EXOGENOUS apply and before the run that consumes it** (SE-23, SE-38): `exo_pending` is persisted, so the first run after the restore applies the bypass exactly once; a hit that had landed is not dropped by the save, and `post_restore` does not set it.
1057	- **If `apply_suit_damage` exceeds the remaining integrity** (D.7): the amount clamps to 0 and never rejects; at the default knob the rung is set from the band (FAILED), with the knob at 0 the ladder climbs one rung per hold and FAILED comes no sooner than the floor.
1058	- **If a patch targets an integrity at or above `SUIT_PATCH_CAP_BP`** (D.7): `patch_integrity` accepts 0 and changes nothing; below the cap it raises to `min(integrity + bp, SUIT_PATCH_CAP_BP)`. A patched suit is permanently STRAINED, so a hit that lands on a patched suit starts from at most 6000.
1059	- **If a seat walks through a door into a room whose pressure is already two bands lower, or the SE-3 NONE-to-EXPOSED switch happens** (D.12, SE-35) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — design review)*: the compartment changed, so the window re-anchors on the new room, `fire` is false and no `stagger` is submitted; the breath ladder tells the player the rest (the reserve engages, a valve click). A pressure fall inside the compartment the seat already stands in is the only thing D.12 counts. Whether the crossing rule should instead depend on whether the player could see the room they entered is not computable inside Suit and is carried as OQ-39.
1060	- **If a restore lands mid-window** (D.12, SE-38) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — design review)*: `p_age0` and `p_age1` are persisted and `prev_cid` is rebuilt as the current compartment, so the first run after the restore is not a crossing and the trigger fires on exactly the run an uninterrupted session would have fired; a saved age above `STAGGER_WINDOW_RUNS` + 1 fails `SUIT_RESTORE_FIELD_RANGE`.
1061	- **If a DEAD seat is stepped further** (SE-24): the block is frozen: no draw, no drain, no rung evaluation, no cell drain, so its block is unchanged by further runs. A DOWNED seat is not frozen: it keeps breathing and draining.
1062	- **If a breath-axis demand alternates between a vacuum room and a breathable room** (SE-17, RK-3): each return to breathable air drops the rung and resets the counter, so a player who oscillates through a door can stretch reserve-0 time; physically this needs a door and a cycle, and there is no decay branch (the hold resets in full on any non-qualifying run; D.3). The trade-off is stated rather than coded away.
1063	- **If two commands in one tick patch and damage the same seat** (SE-39): they apply in command order inside P2, the hook runs after and reads the final `integrity_bp`; there is no mid-tick intermediate state.
1064	
1065	### Warmth
1066	
1067	- **If the seat stands in a FROST room, or a HOT room below `HEAT_DMG_ONSET_MC`, for twenty minutes** (SE-20, D.4): the load never gains, relaxes `TL_RELAX_EDGE` per run, and the warmth rung holds STRAINED (rime and shiver on the cold side) with cap FULL for as long as the player stays; it can never walk-lock or kill. FREEZING above the shifted onset also gains nothing and relaxes `TL_RELAX_EDGE` (3) per run *(Amended 2026-10-27 — design review)*, so a seat that walks out of the lethal strip into it recovers instead of holding its load there (a seat at `thermal_load` −3900, CRITICAL, drops below 3,700 after 67 runs and leaves the walk-only rung).
1068	- **If the suit is leaking (below `SUIT_LEAK_HP`) in a cold room** (SE-21, D.4): `insul_eff_mc` falls linearly with integrity below `SUIT_LEAK_HP`, so the shifted onset moves back toward `COLD_DMG_ONSET_MC` and a room that was safe at full integrity gains load at gain 8 per run (at `integrity_bp` 2500 and a room 3000 mC below the unshifted onset); the seam jet is already visible. Between `SUIT_LEAK_HP` and `SUIT_HP_OK` (integrity STRAINED, including any patched suit) insulation is full and nothing changes. This is the only coupling between the integrity and warmth axes.
1069	- **If an unpowered home-ship cools** (SE-21, `lsg` SHIP-COLD): with the shift the shifted onset is reached after about 40 minutes, past a 30-minute session, so the home-ship is cold and frightening (breath vapour, rime, shiver) but not lethal inside a session; cold damage lands only in a room whose equilibrium is below the shifted onset. Derelict Authoring must place its lethal cold rooms accordingly, or lower `INSUL_MC`.
1070	
1071	### Holders, carry and loadout
1072	
1073	- **If a pickup targets a full glowstick stack, or a partly full one** (SE-10, SE-12): at 4 of 4 `add_stowed` accepts 0, the item stays in the world and Interaction reports `STACK_FULL`; at 3 of 4 with a pickup of 2 it accepts 1 and leaves 1 in the world. Merge needs equal `def_id`, `condition_bp` and `charge` (IDB-15); a refused merge never destroys an item.
1074	- **If the 30,000 g `part_hull_plate` is stowed** (SE-28, D.6): `cue_load` is HEAVY (the binding Item DB trigger), the HEAVY back-frame shows, movement speed and noise are unchanged by mass (there is no continuous term) but the Controller disables run while any HEAVY item is stowed (D18; `stowed_heavy` is true) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — user rulings)*, and a carried module can still be lifted but the cue stays HEAVY, so the VS-A field check is blind to the carried item until the plate is dropped (OQ-8). A plate reserved by a repair job is out of the pack from the begin tick in both truth branches (SE-41).
1075	- **If the cap becomes NONE while a module is carried** (SE-13): the Controller clears `carry_ref` on the same tick; for that one tick `carried_id` is set in `suit.state` while `carry_ref` is NONE; Interaction's next-tick conversion calls `release_carried`. The autosave hard gate refuses DOWNED, so no generation can capture the mismatch.
1076	- **If `equip_tool` arrives while carrying, channelling, staggered, downed or for slot 4, 5, 6 or an unheld tool** (SE-11) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — user rulings)*: rejected in the order `NOT_ACTIONABLE` (STAGGERED, DOWNED, DEAD), `BUSY` (carrying or channelling), `EMPTY_SLOT`, as immediate-class reasons; while the kernel is paused it is rejected as not `allowed_when_paused`. Equipping the equipped slot is an accepted no-op.
1077	- **If a `tool_suppressant` is somehow in the world at MVP** (SE-14; OQ-34 ruled Option A) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — user rulings)*: that is an authoring lint failure (Derelict Authoring), not a runtime state; slot 4 is unbound and no rule binds the item to a slot, so a stray one stays in the world, and the dormant `replace_tool` and `consume_charge` are never called.
1078	- **If `GLOWSTICK_START_COUNT` is set above `GLOWSTICK_STACK_MAX`** (D.8 A8): boot fails the start-kit assertion; the start kit is never silently clamped.
1079	
1080	### Save, restore and the seams
1081	
1082	- **If `post_restore` finds `controller.state.carry_ref` different from `carried_id` and not both NONE** (SE-13, SE-34): the restore fails `SUIT_RESTORE_CARRY_MISMATCH`, live state untouched; an unsupported `schema_version` fails `SUIT_RESTORE_SCHEMA_UNSUPPORTED`; an out-of-range field (a rung of 4, a hold above its maximum, a stowed count over `stack_max`) fails `SUIT_RESTORE_FIELD_RANGE` or `SUIT_RESTORE_STOWED_OVERFLOW`. Never clamped (SL-15).
1083	- **If a restore lands mid-hold or mid-job** (SE-34, SE-41): `rung_*`, `hold_*` and the per-seat `reserved` counts are persisted and restored exactly, so a restore neither resets nor extends the tell floor and a reserved part stays out of the count (no oracle reappears); `prev_*` copies are rebuilt in `post_restore`, so no spurious edge cue (valve click, stagger) fires after a restore.
1084	- **If an autosave is written while a seat is three seconds from FAILED** (SE-33) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — user rulings)*: the hard gate alone only refuses DOWNED or DEAD, so such a generation would be legal and the death restore would return to it; **ruled 2026-10-27 (OQ-13):** the soft gate defers the save while any bound seat is at CRITICAL or worse (capped at `AUTOSAVE_MAX_DEFER_TICKS`, then RISKY), and the step-back skips any generation written within 600 ticks (`W_MIN_WARNING_S` x `TICK_RATE`) of `T_downed`; a seat three seconds from FAILED is at CRITICAL, so its autosave is deferred, and a STRAINED-yet-doomed seat is caught by the step-back. The doomed-autosave loop (RK-5) is closed.
1085	- **If the seat is IN_POD** (SE-3, SE-35; D60) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — user rulings)*: statuses run against the pod cabin rule (`band_o2` ANOXIC, `band_p` NORMAL, `band_t` COMFORT with no gain, `cid` `POD_CID`): no `draw_air` is called, the source is RESERVE and then NONE, the reserve and the cell drain, the thermal load relaxes and the holds advance; the derivation and the worked numbers are in D.1. Cases on a nominal leg of 945 ticks, which holds 157 runs (158 when the first pod tick is 0, 1 or 2 mod 6, the run residue being 2; the remainder of 3 ticks is carried by the global phase, D.1): (a) boarding with a full reserve spends 47,100 mGU (15.7 s) and arrives with 222,900 (222,600 at 158 runs); (b) boarding with 107,400 mGU or less (at `N_hi` 158, d 300) reaches walk-only and the mark before the leg ends; (c) boarding at reserve 0 reaches CRITICAL at run 100 (10 s) and the leg ends at run 157 or 158, before FAILED (run 250), and arrival in breathable air drops the rung on the first run; only a leg of 250 runs or more (1,495 ticks or more) can reach FAILED, and then the Controller's DOWNED and DEAD apply as anywhere; (d) a leaking suit adds 150 mGU per run (23,550 over 157 runs); (e) the valve click plays once on the transition edge when the source becomes RESERVE on entering the pod from a breathable room and the disengage click once on arrival, never per run (the avatar is not drawn in the pod, but the audio plays), so the click now also marks a hop *(Amended 2026-10-27 — re-review, delegated ruling R6)*: Audio and the first-sortie onboarding (OQ-42) must not teach "click = this room is unbreathable" without that exception (OQ-48, a playtest watch).
1086	- **If `room_at` answers NONE and `loco_state` is not IN_POD** (SE-3, SE-35): a defect-only state (BDY-29) is EXPOSED to the EXTERIOR (vacuum, cold), never to the last room's bands, and everything keeps running. A seat with no room at spawn is an authoring failure, not a runtime state.
1087	- **If the Graph's baseline stagger is reverted (all three hooks to offset 0, a data-only change)** (SE-1) *(Amended 2026-10-28 — cross-GDD fix)*: Suit is re-registered at offset 0 too; if only one registration moves, the kernel only warns about the never-co-running pair, so A12 fails boot and a half-moved build cannot ship.
1088	- **If the kernel is paused** (SE-32): no ticks, no runs, no drift of any counter; `equip_tool` and every mutator are rejected, so a solo player cannot re-arm with time stopped mid-tell.
1089	
1090	### Co-op hooks (recorded, not built)
1091	
1092	- **If four seats each carry a full stack of glowsticks** (SE-10, A11): 16 is above `MAX_DEPLOYABLES_LIVE` 8; the extra sticks enter the Emitter State's visible evict-wane rather than an instant removal; D.8 A11 raises a boot warning (not a failure) above one seat, so this case is reachable; at the start count of 2 the four-seat total is 8 and fits, and the surplus appears only as sticks are picked up. The CONFLICT is recorded for Vertical Slice B (OQ-14).
1093	- **If a player rejoins on a different peer** (SE-2): the seat's record is keyed by PlayerId, so the reserve, cell, rungs and kit are unchanged; no `peer_id` appears in the block. A new seat's `default_state()` grants the start kit with full reserve and cell and all rungs at 0.
1094	- **If two seats default their beam shape** (SE-9): seat n takes `shape_id` n, so identity is unique among four; a picker on the new-campaign screen (Vertical Slice B; none at MVP, CT-24) may change it before `bind_beam`, and the choice is immutable afterwards.
1095	- **If a crewmate would revive a DOWNED seat** (SE-24): `revive` is declared and dormant in the MVP; its Vertical Slice B contract is the minimal change that clears the integrity terminal condition (`integrity_bp` raised to `SUIT_LEAK_HP`, OQ-18), because breath and warmth are the room's and no revive can fix them.
1096	
1097	### Hallucination interplay
1098	
1099	- **If a Vertical Slice A Filter wraps `true_value("suit.warmth", player_id)` and shows a warm numeral while the seat is in a FROST room** (SE-25, SE-29): the reading changes and every body cue stays true: breath vapour, rime and the shiver are functions of `band_t` and `suit.state` only; the player can falsify the numeral by looking at their own shoulder plates or listening to their breath at the cost of the lamp and a moment of attention. A Filter that tries to move the chest point or edit overlay visibility violates the cue-purity lint (AC-SE-26).
1100	- **If a phantom item is shown as carried or a phantom part is shown in the pack** (SE-28, SE-41): Suit holds no instance for a phantom, so `cue_load` and the back-frame do not change; the breath is the honest field check, and the reservation API prevents a repair channel from revealing a phantom through a spent or unspent part.
1101	- **If a hallucination makes a crewmate look like a monster and the player harms them** (SE-23): the gate is Sanity's, applied in Interaction's `validate` on the actor; Suit records the per-step exogenous damage as it would for any source, the victim's rung tracks it, and the victim really dies (the user's decision); Suit never reads sanity and never softens the landing.
1102	- **If sanity is lowest** (SE-29): in the MVP no reading is corrupted and no cue changes; the same seat in the same room produces byte-identical cue outputs (AC-SE-26's mutated-sanity replay).

1232	## Visual/Audio Requirements
1233	
1234	*Requirements, not outputs.* Suit draws nothing and plays nothing itself (it is a `SIM` block and a divisor-6 hook, H10). It publishes true values (`view(player_id)` cue levels, `true_value`) that the Avatar Presenter (the Controller's), the HUD & Suit Layer, 2D Lighting & Occlusion, Failure & Trail and Adaptive Audio & Tells conform to. This section lists what each of them must be able to show and sound, in which class of truth, colour and motion, and which assets that implies. The art-director signs the look and the audio-director the sound; evidence is a retained screenshot in `production/qa/evidence/` (BLOCKING). Every requirement placed on a system whose GDD is a draft or absent is **provisional** and must be repeated by it (Interactions). Citations `ab:N` are art-bible lines, `ab §x.y` its sections.
1235	
1236	### Art stance
1237	
1238	The suit is the one place the art bible's two registers touch the same avatar: the **sprite** (an anchor, true on every client, `ab §5.3`) and the **reading** (the suit layer, lie-capable by architecture, `ab §7.0`). The sort into those two registers is the whole visual rule: *what the player's body shows is true and cannot be removed, added or tinted by Sanity or Attention; what the HUD numbers show is a reading that the art bible's grammar already allows to lie and that Suit leaves honest in the MVP (SE-29).* A body cue costs light to see; a reading costs nothing — Principle 1 applied to the avatar: to check the numeral against the body the player must spend light (`ab:36`, `ab:738`). The three tie-breakers of `ab §1`: (1) does it make the player spend something — rime, fog and the vapour puff exist only where light lands on the sprite; (2) is it in the world, not on top of it — a leaking suit shows a jet, not a banner; (3) if the player is lied to here, does the lie leak the sane palette — only the five readings can lie, and only with the violet gleam, glide and sound of HR-5.
1239	
1240	| Cite | Rule | What it forces on Suit |
1241	|---|---|---|
1242	| Principle 1 (`ab:36-42`) | True occlusion, never a mask | No screen-space body effect of any kind: no vignette, tunnel, blur, edge frost or hypoxia distortion (SE-27). The beam is never dimmed by low charge (SE-8, EM-8). |
1243	| Principle 2 (`ab:44-55`) | State lives in the sprite or medium; failure is a trail in the loop's own hue | Suit has no loop. Body state is overlays on the sprite and puffs in the beam, never icons over the head. Hue is redundant with shape. |
1244	| Principle 3 (`ab:57-66`) | Emission is exposure | Nothing on the body glows; every overlay is unlit albedo. Only the engine-rendered beam and the landed glowstick pool are light. |
1245	| Corollary (`ab:68-76`) and 4.4 (`ab:422-445`) | Lies leak violet or flesh; anchors never shift | No Suit asset samples violet (270-330 degrees) or flesh (5-30 degrees). |
1246	| 2.9, 2.10 (`ab:228-252`) | Overlay never changes tempo; crew loss goes dark, no red, no text | Cue cadence derives from vitals only. DEAD adds no screen beat (SL-8): the lamp going out is the only Suit-side light event. |
1247	| 3.1-3.2, 4.0-4.2 (`ab:276-408`) | Silhouette test; beam shape is identity; Chemlight is world light only | Overlays keep the circle-on-rectangle read. The hand-rail glowstick glyph is Paper White, **never** Chemlight `#86B896` (`ab:384`, `ab:396`). |

1250	| 7.0-7.3 (`ab:726-851`), HR-1 to HR-15 (`ab:968-986`) | The HUD is a suit; reading register; settle, tremor, glide; red never text; reduced motion; 3 Hz | Readings and marks below. |

1253

Every row's never-source: Sanity, Attention, any `PERCEPTION_OUT` view, any filtered value (SE-25).

1256	| # | Visual | Class | Driving true value |
1257	|---|---|---|---|

1284	**Rules that follow.** **VA-R1 Pure function:** VA-1 to VA-9 and VA-11 are redrawn each presentation frame from the last committed cue levels only and carry no state of their own; the first frame after a restore shows exactly the restored levels, with no residue particles and no tween. **VA-R2 One class per visual:** the O2 numeral (RD) never drives fog (CL), and a body cue is never read back from a reading. **VA-R3 No lying variant:** `suit.state` and `view` hold true values only; no Suit asset exists in a "lying" variant — the lie is the HUD's gleam, glide and sound over a true reading's slot (HR-5). **VA-R4 The warning mark is not a truth channel:** it sits beside its reading, so it lies when the reading lies; the honest second opinion is always the body and the room (SE-30). **VA-R5 Chemlight is for light only.** **VA-R6 Unlit means unseen:** body cues are visible to the wearer and to crewmates only while some light reaches the sprite; this is the intended cost ("you look cold" costs only light, `ab:528`) and is why every body cue also has an audio witness.
1285	
1286	### Event to feedback table
1287	
1288	Owners: Presenter = Avatar Presenter (Controller GDD), HUD = HUD & Suit Layer, Lighting = 2D Lighting & Occlusion, F&T = Failure & Trail, Audio = Adaptive Audio & Tells, I = Interaction, E = Emitter State. Visual changes step on the next presentation frame after the 0.1 s run and never fade or ease. Priority is MVP unless stated. "Mark" is the warning mark (VA-22).

1291	|---|---|---|

1293	| Reserve engages | Nothing new visual on the avatar (fog is already level 1 when the air was THIN first, and level 1 arrives on the same run when the rung was 0); the witness is audio, the valve click and then the closed breath cadence, with the caption `cap.suit.valve.engage` and the strip dial swap *(Amended 2026-10-27 — re-review)* | CL + BF |

1295	| Breath FAILED | Down animation, fog level 2 persists, lamp stays on (Presenter, E); the carried module is dropped by Interaction next tick | AN |
1296	| Top-up at a lit O2_TANK port (I verb V7, an MVP verb by user ruling) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — user rulings)* | Sight-glass falls (In-World Instruments); the reserve numeral ticks up in whole steps (HUD); work loop (Presenter). Dormant PASSIVE configuration: no visual beyond the reading | W + RD |
1297	| Warmth STRAINED, cold side (FROST) | Rime level 1 on helmet crown and pack top edge; shiver at rest; vapour (already from COOL); warmth reading zone band changes | AN + CL + RD |

1301	| Integrity damage lands | The integrity reading steps down; no body flash, no shake, no red (HR-13); crossing `SUIT_LEAK_HP` starts the jet | RD |
1302	| Integrity below `SUIT_LEAK_HP` | Seam vapour jet from the pack seam while below; the reserve reading falls faster | AN |

1306	| Cell reaches zero (`force_off`) | The cone vanishes in one step on that tick (E, Lighting): a hard cut — a fade is a dimming lie, a flicker is the flare's word (`ab:286`) | PR |

1315	| `set_carried` / `release_carried` | Carry-walk set (8 frames), module held below the lamp, carried glyph appears; load layer by carried class / back to the walk set, glyph clears | AN + RD |

1318	| Pod entry / exit (D60) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — user rulings)* | The valve click on the source transition edge only: once when `breath_src` becomes RESERVE on entering from breathable air and once on the disengage at arrival, never per run (audio only: the avatar is not drawn in the pod) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — re-review, delegated ruling R6)*; all cues and marks run as anywhere; no extra sprite | BF |

1321	| Readings corrupted by Sanity (VS-A, SE-29) | The five readings carry the violet fringe gleam `#B07BE6`, one HR-5 motion signature (glide on a dial needle; continuous tick or stale on a numeral) and a sound signature (HUD, Sanity); body cues VA-1 to VA-9 do not change | RD |
1322	| Crewmate within light, co-op (VS-B) | Their rime, fog, stagger, carry pose, back-frame, seam jet and beam shape drawn from `SHARED_SUMMARY` cue fields (CONFLICT VA-A5); their vitals are not on the crew strip (`ab:902`) | AN |
1323	
1324	### Body-cue specifications
1325	
1326	All overlays are authored in the 80x80 crewmate cell (`ab:1041`), five drawn facings (S, SE, E, NE, N; three mirrored), flat unshaded albedo with `_nrm`/`_spc` pairing where a surface reads, binary alpha, 2x2 minimum feature, no single-pixel noise (`ab:579`). The 1 px Void Steel contour belongs to the body sprite only; overlays sit inside it and the 2 px violet-fringe clearance outside stays free (`ab:1032`). **Cue-level scheme (D.10, adopted everywhere):** `cue_cold` 0 none, 1 vapour only (COOL), 2 rime level 1 plus shiver (FROST, warmth STRAINED), 3 rime level 2 (warmth CRITICAL and FAILED); `cue_fog` 0 to 2.
1327	
1328	- **VA-C1 Rime (warmth axis, cold side).** Sits **only on shell plates** (helmet, pack, forearms, knees) and **never at a fitting** (seam, clamp, visor rim, pack coupling), so it cannot read as a coolant leak (`ab:528`). Coolant Ice `#C8E6F5` only, static, no animation, no glint, no emission. Level 1 (`cue_cold` 2): 2x2 to 3x3 px clusters on the helmet crown and pack top edge only, about 6-10 clusters. Level 2 (`cue_cold` 3): clusters on all four plate groups, crown and shoulder line continuous. The levels differ by **plate-group count** (2 versus 4), a shape change that survives 50 % zoom and greyscale. FAILED adds no third level. Coolant Ice (L* about 91) collides with the Tungsten beam core (L* about 92) in greyscale; the backup is location (plates of a figure) and shape (static clusters, not a cone) — the existing 4.7 row "Tungsten vs Coolant Ice", no new row. Rime at a fitting, a drip, or any rime without `cue_cold` at or above 2 is a defect.
1329	- **VA-C2 Visor fog (breath axis).** Inside the visor strip only (at least 4 px high with a 2x2 glint, `ab:1018`); bad air is never cold, and keeping the two on different sprite zones keeps them separable. Three whole-strip values that survive 50 % zoom (strip 2 px, glint below the 2x2 minimum, so **no level may depend on the glint or a small patch**): L0 clear (Void Steel, L* about 5, with glint); level 1 (`cue_fog` 1): the whole strip steps to Graphite mid `#2A303A` (L* about 20), glint halved; level 2 (`cue_fog` 2): the whole strip Graphite lit `#5C6670` (L* about 43), no glint. STRAINED has no mark, so level 1 is its only sprite witness. Needs `_alb` plus `_spc`. Never fed by sanity, Attention, the Filter or the cold.
1330	- **VA-C3 Breath vapour (visual half of the breath cue).** Present only when `band_t` is COOL or colder; the absence of vapour in a warm room is itself information. A puff leaves the helmet front on each exhale, drifts about 6-10 px along the facing and dies in about 0.8 s; 4x4 and one 8x8 texture (the denser FROST and FREEZING puff), nearest-filtered, binary alpha ("pixels, not fog", `ab:1073`), at most 8 particles alive per seat. Graphite lit `#5C6670`, unlit albedo, visible only where engine light lands. **No loop hue:** O2 Cyan would read as a leaking O2 pipe (Principle 2) and Coolant Ice would duplicate rime. One puff per breath event, on the same cadence step as the audio, published by Suit as a cue step and never invented by the Presenter. Pack-breathing amplitude (idle 2-3 px, `ab:520`) stays constant: it is the Controller's idle and is **not** the load cue (SE-28).
1331	- **VA-C4 Heat side: no body cue (ruling).** SE-20 left "sweat, shimmer" to the art-director. Sweat needs skin (`ab §5.1`: no skin anywhere) and a shimmer on the sprite is a distortion, which Principle 1 forbids. HOT and SCORCH are witnessed by the room (scorch trail, ember glow, F&T), the warmth reading's zone band and mark, the audio fan, and SCORCH's integrity damage landing as the seam jet. The Graph's HOT-band text ("sweat, heat shimmer") is not implemented by Suit; a room-level shimmer, if any, is F&T's or Lighting's call and must satisfy Principle 1. **Thin spot** (OQ-20): a deaf or hard-of-hearing player gets only the reading and the room for HOT STRAINED to CRITICAL.

Rules cite their `SE-n`, formulas their `D.n`. Examples use only the ids of SE-40. Fixtures are the Graph's locked D.15 rows (DOOR-BREACH, O2-ROOM, O2-SHIP, FREEZE-BREACH, SHIP-COLD) unless stated; a fixture time is "derived; the Graph harness confirms to +/-15 %", so an absolute step is asserted only against the locked harness output and the relative form always holds. `s_h` below is the run on which the Graph first reports HYPOXIC with LOW pressure (64 in the locked DOOR-BREACH harness). **Fixture traces are pinned by hash** *(Amended 2026-10-27 — design review)*: every Graph fixture an auto criterion uses is the committed harness output `tests/unit/suit/fixtures/graph_<fixture>.trace`, pinned by its SHA-256 in `tests/unit/suit/fixtures/graph_traces.sha256`; a changed hash fails the test as "Graph fixture changed" before any Suit assertion runs, so a Graph retune surfaces as a fixture update and never as a silent Suit failure. **Split criteria:** a bare id such as AC-SE-1, 7, 8, 9, 12, 13, 19, 20, 21, 23, 28, 31, 34, 36, 38, 42, 43, 44, 45, 47, 49, 53, 62, 75, 79, 83 or 91, cited elsewhere in this document, means all of its lettered sub-criteria.

38: the phantom-salvage field check and its blind-audio precondition (AC-SE-42), a hook-offset stagger if the Graph takes one. **Vertical Slice B:** `revive` (OQ-18), the `SH
> You have just over a minute of yourself on your back, and you know it because you topped up at the cargo-bay tank before the pod hop, watched the sight-glass drop, and felt the leg take its share of seconds *(Amended 2026-10-27 — user rulings)*. You could finish the cut. You decide not to. You walk out, and halfway down the corridor the valve clicks again and the breath opens up: room air. The reserve stays where you left it. You will pay for this sortie at the tank, in ship O2 the scrubber will take minutes to give back.
>
> The other run of this moment: you stayed. The reserve runs down, the warning mark appears on the strip's breath dial (which has been showing the reserve since the valve clicked), your body stumbles (the stagger) and will not run. Then the reserve is gone, ten-odd seconds later you are on the deck, and the Controller's thirty-second window is all there is. Nobody hears it. The game restarts you at the autosave before the derelict. You lost twenty minutes. You did not lose the knowledge that a door in derelict B can blow.

**Timeline of the "stayed" branch** (illustrative, one baseline: a full reserve of 270,000 mGU at the breach with no pod leg before it; a default pod leg beforehand (D.1) would remove 157 runs x 300 = 47,100 mGU = 15.7 s of reserve, so every reserve-driven row from about 66 s on would arrive about 15.7 s sooner *(Amended 2026-10-27 — re-review, delegated ruling R6)*; every duration is a `[PH]` value the Formulas section owns and the Graph harness confirms to ±15 %; timings derived from the DOOR-BREACH closed forms, `[derived; Graph harness to confirm]`; defaults: `RESERVE_S` 90 s, `RESERVE_WARN_S` 30 s `[PH]`, `RUNG_MIN_TICKS` 600 ticks = 10 s, `HYPOX_FAIL_S` 15 s `[PH]`; `p_o2` falls below the HYPOXIC boundary `HYPOXIA_PP` at about 6.4 s, *inside* the LOW band, not at DECOMP, because `p_o2` tracks total pressure):

| t (s) | Graph (true room) | Suit axis: breath | Body cue (consequence channel) | Reading (HUD; lie-capable architecture, honest in MVP) | Cap |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | breach opens | OK | — (draught and hiss are the Graph's and Failure & Trail's) | O2 numeral starts to fall with the room | FULL |
| ~2.5 | `band_o2` THIN | **STRAINED** (the first cue; entry to STRAINED is not rate-limited) | breath quickens and shortens (thin signature) | numeral crosses a zone | FULL |
| ~5.6 | `band_p` LOW | STRAINED | draught and hiss at the opening (Graph/F&T) | — | FULL |
| ~6.4 | `band_o2` HYPOXIC (boundary `HYPOXIA_PP`) | STRAINED (source flips ROOM to RESERVE) | **valve click; breath switches to the closed reserve cadence** (the visor fog has been at level 1 since about 2.5 s) | reserve reading becomes active; the strip's dial swaps to the suit O2 *(Amended 2026-10-27 — re-review)* | FULL |
| ~14 | `band_p` DECOMP (boundary `DECOMP_P`) | STRAINED | lean, draught audio | — | FULL |
| ~36 | VACUUM | STRAINED | closed cadence, fog | — | FULL |
| ~66 | — | target CRITICAL begins (reserve at or below `RESERVE_WARN_S` of air) | breath shortens again | — | FULL |
| ~76 | — | **CRITICAL** (condition held `RUNG_MIN_TICKS`) | **stagger** (falling edge, Controller's `STAGGER_TICKS` 30) then walk-only; fog dense | **warning mark on the strip's breath dial (showing the reserve)** | WALK_ONLY |
| ~96 | — | terminal condition begins (unbreathable, reserve 0) | breath laboured, no source | reserve reads empty | WALK_ONLY |
| ~111 | — | **FAILED** (terminal held `HYPOX_FAIL_S`) | collapse | — | NONE → DOWNED |
| ~141 | — | FAILED | — | — | DEAD at the Controller's `DOWN_TO_DEATH_TICKS` 1800 → Save/Load restart |

First body cue to FAILED is about 109 s here (the floor is `SUIT_MIN_WARNING_S` 20 s). The worst case the limiter guarantees — a seat already at reserve 0 entering an unbreathable room — is first cue to FAILED of at least `SUIT_MIN_WARNING_S`, then 30 s DOWNED. **Escape at any point before about 141 s works**: descent is never rate-limited (SE-17), so the run the seat stands in breathable air the breath axis drops to what the air demands and the cap rises; at `death_tick` the Controller checks the cap first.

**Second beat (derelict A, cold, the stowed plate).** The dead-bus wreck is unpowered and cold. Your breath smokes in your own cone (COOL); then rime creeps over your shoulder plates and you start to shiver (FROST); the panel's warmth reading is still in its first zone — your body is ahead of the number, which is the order the fantasy wants. You stow the 30 kg hull plate and your breathing deepens and slows, with a pack-creak under it (the load signature) — a different sound from thin air, which is shallower and faster. The haul has a sound. That sound is how, later (Vertical Slice A), you will know a "treasure" crate is garbage before you carry it home.

**Third beat (the falsifier; Vertical Slice A illustration only — MVP suit readings are not corrupted).** At low sanity the warmth reading glides up, slow and uncaused, with a violet fringe at its glyph (the art bible's HR-5 tell). Your breath is still smoking and you are shivering. You believe the shiver. You go home.

**Pillar alignment.** *Pillar 1 (primary), verbatim:* "Three channels are **inviolable** — no hallucination may ever alter them: **Physical consequences.** A pipe may *look* fixed, but the room still gets cold, the air still thins, the pressure still drops." The body is where "the room still gets cold" is felt: breath vapour, rime, shiver, visor fog and the stagger are that clause rendered on the player. *Design test:* "hidden stat vs. a visibly leaking pipe → the pipe." Applied: the reserve is a stat, so it has physical witnesses (the valve click on engage, the breath changing source, the tank sight-glass dropping on top-up); a damaged suit is a stat, so below `SUIT_LEAK_HP` it *visibly leaks* (the seam vapour jet) — the pillar's own pipe, on a person. The human channel ("a crewmate's own light beam (colour and shape) are never faked") is why the beam shape is a per-seat, campaign-immutable identity and why Suit sets it exactly once. *Pillar 2, verbatim:* "Every breach is preceded by a tell a careful player could have perceived (sound, light, gauge drift, hull stress)." *Design test:* "breach fires at a hidden threshold vs. breach preceded by a 10–30 second escalating tell → the tell." The Graph's fairness gate covers the ship, not the body ("Player death is Suit's rule" (LS-13)), so Suit carries its own: `SUIT_MIN_WARNING_S` from the first body cue to FAILED, enforced by the rung limiter; the low-cell tell `CELL_WARN_S` sits inside the same 10-30 s window. *Pillar

**Design tests (this system).**
1. **The body first (system test).** *When a vitals change could reach the player only through a reading vs. through a body cue they perceive without looking at the HUD → the body cue first.* Every rung change on every axis (breath, warmth, integrity) that has a physical consequence, and every weight-class step, has at least one closed-list body cue; the reading is its second opinion. **The deliberate exclusions are integrity STRAINED and the heat side (exception E2, below)** (`SUIT_LEAK_HP ≤ integrity_bp < SUIT_HP_OK`): that rung changes no cap, no insulation, no drain and no onset, so it has no body cue and needs none; it is carried by the integrity reading's zone band alone and nothing lethal hides there (SE-21, SE-22, OQ-19 ruled; CD-GDD-ALIGN 2026-10-26). **The heat side (HOT and SCORCH, STRAINED to CRITICAL) is the named exception E2** (OQ-20 ruled): it has no sprite or closed-list witness (VA-C4); its pack fan whirr is a reading-class audio signature (SE-26), so the system test is met there by the reading, the mark, the room and the fan and not by a body cue *(Amended 2026-10-27 — re-review)*. Per-axis corollaries: engaging the reserve is audible on the run it happens (no silent engagement); every warmth rung above OK is visible on the sprite or audible before any damage ramp starts, and no readable body-temperature number exists; integrity damage without a visible landing is forbidden (below `SUIT_LEAK_HP` the suit visibly leaks, and that is also where the leak 
2. **Cue or reading, never both unlabeled.** *When a new player-facing suit value is proposed vs. it is classed as exactly one of a closed-list body cue (never corruptible), an HR-3-class reading (lie-capable by architecture), or the one TRUTH-class bit `suit.alarm` (a reading that is never lie-capable) → classed as exactly one.* *(Amended 2026-10-27 — user rulings)* Rule SE-26 holds the list.
3. **The lamp costs something physical.** *When a free infinite flashlight vs. a beam the player rations → the rationed one* — within the Item Database's rule that scarcity comes from "O2, power, Attention and finite parts — not from tool upkeep": the cell's refill is ship power, not a part sink.

**Under hallucination the fantasy deepens rather than breaks.** The split is the Graph's and the Emitter State's, applied to the body. The left column is guaranteed by construction (the block is `SIM`; cue state is a pure function of the occupant's compartment band enums and `suit.state`; no Suit code reads Sanity, Attention or any `PERCEPTION_OUT` view, CR-12). The right column is the five readings, which reach the HUD only through the Filter's `perceived`, which wraps `true_value(key, player_id)`, with keys `suit.o2`, `suit.reserve`, `suit.integrity`, `suit.warmth`, `suit.charge` — **architected lie-capable, not corrupted in the MVP.**

| Cannot lie (consequence channel — this GDD guarantees) | Can lie (reading register — Sanity and the Perception Filter only; Vertical Slice A at the earliest) |
|---|---|
| Breath: cadence, source (room versus reserve), load signature, vapour puff | The O2 dial arc and numeral (`suit.o2`) |
| The reserve valve click (breath family, see SE-26) | The reserve reading (`suit.reserve`) |
| Visor fog | The integrity reading (`suit.integrity`) |
| Rime on the shell plates; shiver | The warmth reading (`suit.warmth`) |
| Stagger, walk-only, DOWNED (the `locomotion_cap` effects) | The beam and tool charge reading and its cell-whine sound signature (`suit.charge`) |
| The seam vapour jet below `SUIT_LEAK_HP`; the HEAVY back-frame | Not here: the glowstick rail count is an **anchor** with no `true_value` key, honest at MVP and Vertical Slice A (HUD HS-34, Sanity SN-19; OQ-6 closed; the suppressant count left the MVP rail, OQ-34 ruled) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — user rulings)* |
| The beam's colour, shape, and the moment it actually goes out (`force_off` at zero cell) | — |
| The one-bit ship-alarm reading `suit.alarm`: a TRUTH-class bit, never lie-capable (a third class beside the cue and the lie-capable reading, SE-26) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — user rulings)* | — |

**Required leak.** Any corrupted suit reading carries the art bible's HR-5 tri-modal tell: violet fringe gleam, one HR-5 motion signature (glide on a dial needle; continuous tick or stale on a numeral), a sound signature. Subtle is allowed; absent is not. Suit states this as a requirement on the HUD & Suit Layer, Sanity and the Perception Filter; it implements none of it.

**The falsifier ladder this hands the player (cheapest first).** (1) *Listen to your breath* — free, always available, works in the dark; thin air is fast and shallow, reserve is close and dry, load is slow and creaking. (2) *Look at your own body in your own light* — vapour shows in your cone; rime and fog are on your sprite; cost: the lamp is on (exposure, cell). (3) *Look at the room* — frost on surfaces, draught, the Graph's trails; cost: light and time. (4) *Move* — walk to a room you know is good; the valve clicks back, the shiver stops, the stagger lifts; cost: time and the sortie. (5) *A crewmate's visor in your beam* (Vertical Slice B, the human channel) — the crew strip relays no vitals; the check is lighting them; cost: trust and light. (6) *Time* — the reserve really empties, or it does not.

**Why the MVP keeps suit readings honest.** The MVP's one hallucination class (b) lives on ship instruments, where the room is the witness. A first-time player's only death clock should not lie before the cue ladder has been playtested — Pillar 2 protects learning before Pillar 4 tests it. The architecture is ready; the switch is Vertical Slice A's. *Risk carried:* if Vertical Slice A never turns it on, the "my numeral says warm, my breath says cold" moment — the best teaching beat this system offers Pillar 4 — never ships. Recorded as an Open Question for Sanity & Hallucination Rules.

**Guard against borrowing lies from the wrong source.** Hypoxia, cold and load produce *no* screen effect, tunnel, blur, double vision or "confusion" state. The body is honest even when it is failing; only Sanity lies. A hypoxia hallucination would be an unfalsifiable lie with the wrong owner.

**Tone and language.** *Use:* suit, the seal, breath, the reserve, the valve, top up, the tank, the cell, chest lamp, lamp, beam, go dark, visor, fog, rime, shiver, stagger, walk, down (downed), the hand (the tool in hand), the rail, stow, the haul, carry, the plate, the leak, patch. *Avoid:* meter words for the body (*health, HP, hit points, stamina* as a stat, *hunger, armour, encumbrance, weight* as a readout, *body temperature, oxygen meter, O2 bar*); inventory words (*inventory, backpack slots, bag, capacity, loadout screen*); light words already ruled by the Emitter State (*flashlight* — implies hand-held, the lamp is chest-mounted; *torch* for the beam — reserved for the Vertical Slice A deployable; *battery* for the suit's own store — that is a Graph node kind, the suit has a *cell*; *visibility, detection, stealth, light level*); and banned screen effects as vocabulary (*vignette, tunnel vision, blur, confusion, dizziness, screen frost*). *Register:* terse, physical, second person in fantasy prose; verbs of the body (breathe, shiver, stumble, carry); no heroic diction ("survive!") and no warning text on screen — the warning mark is a glyph, never words.

**Reference techniques — adopt and reject, precisely.**

| Reference | Adopt | Reject |
|---|---|---|
| **Pandorum** | The chest-mounted, hands-free lamp that swings with the body (user decision, binding); the suit as the claustrophobic, breathing frame of the experience. | A hand-held torch traded against tools (the hand point is lightless). |
| **Project Zomboid** | "Death is a bitch. It happens." (user): death is lethal, quiet and final for the interval; states are discrete, named by cause and escalate in steps. | The moodle icon strip as the primary channel — Suit's states live on the body (sprite, breath); the HUD carries readings only; no hunger, boredom or fatigue stats. |
| **Metro 2033 / Exodus** | The reading-versus-cue split: the filter timer is a reading on the wrist; the fogging visor and laboured breath are the body. Breath as the primary air cue. | Manual mask-wipe and filter-swap inputs (a chore verb; the reserve is topped up at the ship). |
| **Dead Space** | Diegetic state on the suit itself rather than floating UI. | The RIG health spine — a bar painted on the body is still a meter. Our on-body state is rime, fog and a leak jet, not a gauge. |
| **Subnautica** | The O2 numeral as a reading of a real reserve; breath audio as the warning. | Instant blackout at zero (we have the rung floor and the 30 s DOWNED window); tank-capacity upgrades (no progression). |
| **Barotrauma** | "Suit required" as a property of the place (the DECOMP band); pressure and oxygen as the room's clock. | The diving-suit speed penalty (the Pillar 4 secondary test); swapping loose tank items from inventory (top-up at a lit port instead). |
| **Death Stranding** | Load you can perceive on the body (the haul is felt). | The balance-and-stumble minigame and any mass-to-speed term (mass never changes speed or noise); cargo weight readout. |
| **Don't Starve** | Cold as a staged, legible threat with a lag before damage. | The screen-edge frost overlay (a vignette by another name) and the readable thermometer. |
| **Beyond the Aquila Rift** | The comforting false reality and the one physical detail that betrays it — the body as that detail. | Any authored "reveal" moment (anti-pillar: no authored story). |
| **Alien: Isolation / Amnesia** | Already ruled in the Emitter State's references; cited, not restated. | — |

**Anti-pillar guard rails (the Player Fantasy's close).**
1. **The suit has no weapon.** No tool carries damage, accuracy, range-as-damage or armour; the suppressant repels or distracts and its effect is Attention's and Horror's and **does not ship at MVP** (AT-19, HE-39); the item itself is out of the MVP kit (OQ-34 ruled Option A) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — user rulings)*. *(Not a combat game.)*
2. **`apply_suit_damage` is a landing, never a decision.** Suit records harm; whether a crewmate may harm another is the Sanity gate applied in Interaction's `validate`. Suit never reads sanity. *(No intentional PvP.)*
3. **No progression on the body.** No insulation items, cell or reserve upgrades, shape unlocks or brightness levels. One suit, one kit, campaign-long. *(Not a freeform builder.)*
4. **No inventory and no weight readout.** The rail shows tools, the glowstick count and the carried module; nothing else *(Amended 2026-10-27 — user rulings)*. Mass is heard in the breath, never read.
5. **No hidden stat without a witness.** Every suit stat that can kill (reserve, warmth load, integrity) has a body cue at each rung that has a physical consequence. Integrity STRAINED (`SUIT_LEAK_HP ≤ integrity_bp < SUIT_HP_OK`) is inert by design: cap FULL, no drain, full insulation (SE-21), so it carries no witness and hides nothing lethal; the first integrity consequence is the leak, and its witness is the seam jet on the same run. A rung with a consequence and no witness is forbidden (the P1 test: hidden stat versus visibly leaking pipe).
6. **No continuous penalty.** No speed, aim, channel or noise scaling from any vital; only the three cap states.
7. **No sanity or Attention indicator on any suit surface**, and no Suit cue driven by either (`suit.alarm` is the Graph's ship-alarm bit, not an Attention or tell indicator, OQ-37 *(Amended 2026-10-27 — user rulings)*).
8. **No screen effect from the body.** No vignette, tunnel, blur, frost overlay or hypoxia hallucination. The body shows on the sprite and in the sound.
9. **No mercy timer, no self-revive, no death screen.** Recovery while DOWNED happens only when an axis genuinely improves; death restarts from the autosave with no beat, no lights-out, no death screen. The fairness is in the tell floor, not in a second chance.
10. **No free air or light.** The reserve and the cell refill only from real ship stock at a lit port (the dormant PASSIVE configuration, OQ-2, refills the reserve from the room's real O2 and still costs it); no passive regeneration of integrity either (a passive mend would erase attrition and is a hidden regeneration).

1339	### The visual ladder as a timeline
1340	
1341	DOOR-BREACH (V 20, a suited seat with a full reserve; the Graph's LOW at 5.6 s, DECOMP at 14 s, VACUUM at 36 s after the breach), at the default `RUNG_MIN_TICKS` 600 (10 s) per advance; every value `[PLACEHOLDER]`:
1342	
1343	| Time | Breath axis | What the eye sees (lit sprite) | What the ear hears (names only) | Reading (HUD) |
1344	|---|---|---|---|---|
1345	| reserve engages | STRAINED | fog level 1 if the rung was 0, else unchanged | valve click, then the closed breath cadence | reserve reading live; the strip dial swaps to the suit O2 and its numeral falls *(Amended 2026-10-27 — re-review)* |
1346	| reserve at or below `RESERVE_WARN_S`, plus the 10 s hold | CRITICAL | fog level 2; **stagger** once; walk-only | breath shortens, ragged | mark on the strip's breath dial |
1347	| at least 10 s after CRITICAL (source NONE) | FAILED | down animation; fog level 2 persists | laboured breath, then the gasp loop | reserve empty; mark persists |
1348	
1349	The art side needs three **distinct** stages and has them: fog level 1; fog level 2 plus stagger plus mark; down. Descent is never rate-limited, so on re-entering breathable air the next presentation frame steps fog level 2 to level 1 (or off) with no easing. Cold fixture (an unpowered derelict A): COOL puffs begin; FROST adds rime level 1 and the shiver at rest; past the shifted onset, rime level 2, stagger and the mark beside the warmth glyph; then FAILED.
1350	
1351	### Beam, tools and glowsticks (placed or read by Suit)
1352	
1353	- **The beam.** Four shapes are identity and loadout (`bind_beam`, no change-shape action): WIDE 30 degrees / 288 px; NARROW 12 degrees / 384 px; SPLIT 10 degrees each at the Emitter's `SPLIT_AXIS_UNITS`, dark wedge never closing; FAN 60 degrees / 168 px. Tungsten family only; hard outer edge, soft interior falloff. Suit adds no hue, shape or edge change. **No dim, no flicker, no warm-up, no charge visual in the world**: low charge is shown only by the mark at `CELL_WARN_S` and the cell whine; the beam is constant until `force_off`, a one-tick hard cut. The origin is the per-facing chest point (`|x| <= 2`); the tool layer carries no light; carry, work, stagger and shiver frames keep the point and the forward arc clear. Co-op identity is shape plus a helmet trim-band count (1-4); Suit adds no per-player suit colour (`ab:284`).
1354	- **Tools.** Three tool sprites (cutter, welder, scanner; the suppressant is out of the MVP kit, OQ-34 ruled) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — user rulings)*, drawn once, never styled per dialect, carrying **no light**, two states each (held, in use). Tool state is a reading beside the glyph, never an icon swap (`ab:813`, `ab:815`): the scanner has no charge; cutter and welder no state. Slots 4, 5 and 6 are unbound and need no art. The scanner's screen, if it has a lit face, is a world reading (Pillar 4(d), `ab:961`); Suit specifies no scanner readout.
1355	- **Glowsticks.** The pool is Chemlight `#86B896`, radius `GLOWSTICK_RADIUS_TILES` 2, steady for the first 60 % of life then waning in visible integer steps, never flickering, never a cone, non-shadow (Emitter and Lighting own it). Suit's obligations: a stowed stick is inert (no glow, no body light, no HUD glow); the rail count is Paper White (VA-R5); the count steps when the throw is accepted, not when the stick lands. The Chemlight versus O2 Cyan colour-blind pair is carried by shape: a stick is a free-standing omnidirectional pool with no travelling pattern, and the rail glyph is a stick silhouette on the 16 px grid.
1356	
1357	### Reading requirements (the HUD & Suit Layer draws; UI Requirements lists the surfaces)
1358	
1359	| Reading | Glyph (16x16 art px) | Hue rule (7.2: hue only while the source is alive) | Lie slot |
1360	|---|---|---|---|
1361	| Ambient O2 (`suit.o2`; strip dial unless the source is RESERVE) | thin ring clamp with three close chevrons (`ab:807`) | O2 Cyan while any breathable source exists (room air or reserve above zero); Graphite lit when none | yes (HR-5) |
1362	| Suit O2 / reserve (`suit.reserve`, **new HR-3 reading**; on the strip's dial while the source is RESERVE) | the O2 ring clamp with a tank silhouette inside (7.2 forbids abstract symbols) | O2 Cyan while above zero; Graphite lit at zero | yes |
1363	| Integrity (`suit.integrity`) | rivet line, three rivets and a hairline (`ab:811`); reused for the suit because the HUD carries no ship state | Hull Grey | yes |
1364	| Warmth (`suit.warmth`) | no fitting silhouette exists (T and P are not a loop; CONFLICT VA-A8) | no loop hue: Paper White glyph on Ground with a zone band in the dial; the axis is `warmth_pm` 0..1000, COMFORT at 500, band edges 0, 333, 466, 533, 666, 1000 at the defaults (SE-29) | yes |
1365	| Charge (`suit.charge`) | a cell silhouette (Suit's own store, not a Graph battery) | Paper White outline, fill in Tungsten fixture | yes |
1366	| Rail: equipped tool, glowstick count, carried glyph *(Amended 2026-10-27 — user rulings)* | tool profile silhouettes on the 16 px grid (`ab:815`) | Paper White; equipped = Tungsten fixture; glowstick **never Chemlight** | no: the rail count is an anchor (HS-34, SN-19; OQ-6 closed) |

1368	| Ship-alarm mark (`suit.alarm`) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — user rulings)* | the same chamfered Alarm Red square in its own slot, with no reading glyph beside it | Alarm Red on this mark only | **no: TRUTH-class, never lie-capable** |

1370	**Mark discipline (cry-wolf protection).** The mark fires only at CRITICAL on an axis (after the hold, so a transient never shows it) and at `CELL_WARN_S` on the charge reading; STRAINED never shows one (`ab:375`, rarity is the signal). At most six marks (the five rung and charge marks plus the `suit.alarm` mark, which is not rung-based and shows while the bit is 1) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — user rulings)*, all in the same beacon phase (2-3 s period, never faster, never a flicker above 3 Hz, HR-13); under reduced motion they hold solid (HR-8). **Reading motion:** dial arcs settle on change (damped, 0.25-0.4 s, overshoot at most 5 %), except the strip dial's swap between the ambient and the suit O2, which is a snap with no settle so that it lands on the valve click's frame *(Amended 2026-10-27 — re-review)*; numerals tick one step per real change and never tween (`ab:833`, `ab:841`); the reserve ticks upward in whole steps during a top-up. **Tremor is not used for Suit readings** (it means "the loop is loading", `ab:834`). **One HR-5 motion signature** (glide on a dial needle; continuous tick or stale on a numeral) is the lie motion and is not active in the MVP, but each of the five readings must carry the gleam, motion-signature and sound slots so Vertical Slice A switches them on without redrawing (HR-5; test: with hue removed and with audio removed a trained tester still identifies the lying reading). The HUD never shakes, blurs, scales or flashes above 3 Hz in any state, including DOWNED and DECOMP. All reading text sits on opaque Ground plates (`#1C2128`); floors: numerals at least 21 px cap height at 1080p (7 art px), labels at least 15 px (5 art px), stroke at least 2 screen px (HR-12, provisional). The critical strip stays capped at 12 % x 5 % of the frame (`ab:751`); the strip's breath dial swaps between the ambient and suit O2 readings inside the same cap and glyph footprint (SE-30, OQ-41) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — design review)*.
1371	
1372	### Palette, motion and legibility rules
1373	
1374	1. **No new hue.** Only Section 4 hexes: Graphite mid and lit, Hull Grey (thin elements), Void Steel, Coolant Ice (rime only), Tungsten (beam, rail highlight), O2 Cyan and Hull Grey (reading glyph hue), Paper White (UI only), Alarm Red (mark only), Chemlight (the thrown stick's light only).
1375	2. **Sanity palette is off-limits.** The only violet that ever touches a Suit surface is the stage-1 gleam on a lying reading (VS-A), fringe `#B07BE6`, never the core. Hull Grey back-frame beads are the 4.4 near-case: run the sampling test under every Tungsten source, including another player's beam landing on the pack; if the beads fail they fall back to Graphite lit and are never warmed.
1376	3. **Loop hues keep their meaning.** Suit reuses a loop hue only for a *reading* of that loop's medium on the suit panel; the body never wears one (a body cue in O2 Cyan would read as a pipe leak).
1377	4. **Greyscale ladder.** Rime (L* about 91) versus the beam core (about 92) by location and shape; the Graphite-lit fog strip (about 43) versus the Void Steel strip (about 5) is a large step so level 2 survives greyscale; the Alarm Red mark (about 47) versus the violet core (about 43) by shape (a chamfered square, not an edge gleam); Hull Grey beads (about 61) and Fuel Ember (about 61) are never co-located on the Suit.
1378	5. **Stiff-weighted motion** (`ab §5.2`, PC): the Presenter writes only frame index, `flip_h`, integer position, overlay visibility and the beam light's position and rotation — never scale, rotation, skew or tweened offsets on the body. Overlays are visibility toggles between painted levels: no alpha fades, no easing.
1379	6. **Cue grid and clocks.** Levels change on the 0.1 s grid; the Presenter shows the new level on the next presentation frame and does not interpolate. The body cadence is a fixed 12 fps; particles run on the presentation clock, never the sim, and nothing reads them back (EM-29). On restore the Presenter clears every Suit particle pool and re-derives the levels on the first frame; on pause the world freezes undimmed with the particles frozen.
1380	7. **No uncaused motion.** Shiver (cold), stagger (cap edge), jet (leak) and puff (exhale) each have a stated cause in the true state; a cue that moves without its true cause is a defect, and for a reading it is a *glide*.
1381	8. **Zoom.** Overlays are authored at the default and survive the integer zoom-out step (50 % check, tier-2 marks, `ab:576`); particle sizes, offsets and the chest anchor scale by the same integer.
1382	9. **Reduced motion (HR-8).** The shiver holds one frame; vapour and jet still emit (trail propagation is never suppressed, `ab:979`) at a lower rate; marks hold solid.
1383	10. **No flash.** No Suit event flashes the frame; damage, breach, stagger and DOWNED never use a full-frame or HUD flash (`ab:845`).
1384	11. **Own-avatar visibility in the dark.** The wearer's sprite is lit by the wearer's own lamp from its chest origin, so the torso, pack top and helmet front sit inside the lamp's near field while the beam is on. With the beam **off** the sprite is unlit unless a fixture, glowstick or crewmate's beam lands on it: the cues are then invisible by design and the audio witnesses carry them. **Requirement for the lighting spike (`ab §8.12` step 2):** a lit-sprite check in three conditions (own lamp on; own lamp off with a glowstick adjacent; own lamp off in black) with retained screenshots, showing rime and fog levels 1 and 2 distinguishable in the first two and absent in the third. If the own-lamp near field does not reach the helmet at the narrow cone's chest origin, the fallback is a very low "self-lit" rim (a thin specular highlight on the visor and plate edges only) that the spike may add without changing any sim value; it must not count as illumination for prompts and must not alter the revealed radius (an anchor).

1389	Every body cue has an audio witness that starts **no later than its visual** (HR-9, `ab:980`). Mood: dry, close, claustrophobic, mechanical; no musical sting and no danger stinger. Names: breath cadence steps (normal, closed-reserve, thin-air, load), valve click on reserve engage and disengage, pack-creak load layer with a footfall-linked exhale, suit rattle (shiver while moving), pack cooling-fan whirr and tick (heat side, rising with the rung), seam hiss (leak), cell whine at `CELL_WARN_S`, equip clunk, top-up hiss, stagger gasp, glowstick throw, land and wane (the Emitter's), gasp loop (source NONE). **Load versus thin air** are separable by cadence *direction*: load adds depth, the creak layer and a footfall-linked exhale at the air class's own rate; thin air is shallower and faster with no creak; a blind two-clip test (at least 90 % identification, AC-SE-42) is the precondition for the Vertical Slice A phantom-salvage check. Suit emits **no noise** into Attention in the MVP (SE-31): the cadence of these sounds is presentation of a true state, not a stimulus. Cue sounds belong to the consequence channel: a hallucination may neither remove a real valve click nor add one (the Graph's closed list).
